course.title: NestJS — Complete Practical Backend Development Course
course.description: A deep practical NestJS course covering architecture, modules, controllers, providers, dependency injection, REST APIs, DTO validation, pipes, guards, interceptors, exception filters, Prisma/database access, authentication, authorization, security, testing, documentation and a complete student learning-platform backend.
learningOutcomes: Use pipes, guards, interceptors and filters.
Build course, enrollment, progress and submission APIs.
Design a production-ready learning platform backend.

notes.caption: Visual explanation of What Is NestJS?.

notes.text: Study Method

notes.title: NestJS Tip
notes.text: Keep controllers focused on HTTP concerns, services focused on business rules, and persistence logic inside repositories/data-access providers.

Build the backend foundation of a realistic education platform. Static course content can come from dedicated JSON files or a database, while student-specific state such as enrollment, progress and submissions is managed through NestJS APIs and persistent storage.
